If the string satisfies this condition, the function should print "Yes"; otherwise, it should print "No".
fix_specification_reasoning.diagnosis_and_repair_directions:
The flawed specification incorrectly checks if the string is equal to the literal string "[A-Z][a-z]*", which is a regex pattern, not a string comparison. This results in the function always printing "No" unless the input is exactly "[A-Z][a-z]*". The correct approach is to use a regex match to verify the pattern of the string.
Repair Directions:
1. Modify the behavior to use a regex pattern match instead of a string equality check.
2. Use the regex pattern "^[A-Z][a-z]*$" to match the string against the intended condition.
3. If the string matches the pattern, print "Yes"; otherwise, print "No".
